objectives.text: Count groups of real objects up to 10 by touching each one
Recognize the written numbers 1 through 10 in order
Combine two groups of real objects to find the total amount up to 5.
Describe the combined group using the word 'altogether'.
Identify the plus sign and equals sign in a simple addition sentence.
Demonstrate skip counting by placing groups of 5 objects into rows
Identify the number patterns when counting by 5s up to 100
Explain how counting by 5s helps us count faster than counting by 1s
Model two-digit addition problems using base-ten blocks to group ones and tens
Explain when and why we need to regroup ten ones into one ten
Solve two-digit addition equations using the standard regrouping algorithm
Listen to spoken words and isolate the very first sound you hear
Match words that start with the exact same beginning sound
Identify common objects by naming the letter sound they start with
